entities.summary: Giovanni Ferrero is an Italian billionaire businessman. He assumed the leadership of the confectionery company Ferrero SpA after the death of his brother Pietro Ferrero in 2011. His personal fortune is estimated at US$43.8 billion in 2024 according to Forbes, making him the 26th richest in the world, and richest in Italy.
